deficiencies.description: The text refers to primary tumours or deaths occurring as 'things like the meningioma that I was telling you about or in the liver', where meningioma is an example of a tumour. The rewrite states 'when the tumour occurs in a meningioma or in the liver', distorting meningioma into an anatomical location or organ in which a tumour occurs.
